These are three of the most gay kept apps. First up, we have the calculator and if you press share more than calculator, you'll see why. Next up, we got this website called Phrasely, which lets you copy any essay and upload to their free eye humanizer, which will make it sound more human and actually bypass all the eye detectors like GBT0 and turn it in. Lastly, we have reminders. If you're a student or a high functioning person and you're not using these, what are you doing?
